aboutGame.title: Yintoni Sminofu iTekisi?
paragraphs: Sminofu iTekisi licwecwe leMaskandi lika-2026 legcisa laseMzantsi Afrika uSminofu, elikhutshwe nge-16 ka-Okthobha 2026 nge-Sminofu / EMPIRE. Iprojekthi yeengoma ezili-17 ithatha malunga neyure enye nemizuzu emithandathu, ineengoma ezizimeleyo ezilishumi elinambini nentsebenziswano emihlanu ebandakanya abaculi abane beendwendwe.

Igama lisho iteksi ngesiZulu, kwaye irekhodi isebenzisa eso simo semihla ngemihla njengesakhelo sentshukumo, ukuphithizela, incoko, kunye namava okwabelwana ngawo. Isisekelo sayo seMaskandi sibeka isiginkci esichongwe ngomnwe nokubalisa amabali, ngelixa ulandelelwano luhamba ukusuka kwintshayelelo emfutshane kunye nengoma yesihloko ukuya kwisiqingatha sesibini esigcwele iindwendwe phambi kokuvala nge-eMachobeni.

items.question: Yintoni Sminofu iTekisi?
items.answer: Sminofu iTekisi licwecwe leMaskandi lika-2026 legcisa laseMzantsi Afrika uSminofu. Likhutshwe nge-16 ka-Okthobha 2026 nge-Sminofu / EMPIRE kwaye liqulethe iingoma ezili-17 malunga neyure enye nemizuzu emithandathu.

items.question: Zingaphi iingoma ezikwi Sminofu iTekisi?
items.answer: Kukho iingoma ezili-17, kuquka nesingeniso se-1:28 iBenilindele Bani, ingoma yesihloko iTekisi engu-4:06, nesiphelo esingu-3:43 i-eMachobeni. Iingoma ezilishumi elinambini zezomculi yedwa kwaye ezintlanu ziquka amagcisa eendwendwe.

items.question: Ngubani oquka Sminofu iTekisi?
items.answer: Londeka Shangase, Ojakalasi, Njabulo Langa, kunye noZanefa Ngidi bavela kwiingoma ezintlanu. UShangase kuphela undwendwe oluvele kabini, kwiNgithunjiwe nakuNgo December.

items.question: Lithetha ukuthini igama elithi Sminofu iTekisi?
items.answer: Itekisi ligama lesiZulu elithetha iteksi. Icwecwe lisebenzisa eso simo semihla ngemihla ukwenza isakhelo sentshukumo, ukuphithizela, incoko, isidima, kunye namava okwabelwana ngawo.

items.question: Ndingahambisa phi Sminofu iTekisi?
items.answer: Icwecwe liyafumaneka kwiinkonzo zokusasaza ezisemthethweni eziquka Spotify kunye Apple Music. Sebenzisa izikhokelo zeqonga kule ndawo kumakhonkco ecwecwe ngqo kunye neengcebiso zokumamela.
